measurement.lead: A model was asked whether this statement is true.
measurement.stance: asked plainly and from {n} different viewpoints, the probability that it is true ranged by {v}
measurement.wording: asked in {n} different wordings, the probability ranged by {v}
measurement.decline: when allowed to decline, it declined with probability {v}

dimensions.what: How much would people disagree about whether this statement is true?
levels: Essentially everyone would agree on this.
A few people would disagree.
People are genuinely split on this.
This is heavily contested.
This is about as divisive as a statement gets.

dimensions.what: How much are people publicly arguing about this right now?
levels: Nobody is arguing about this right now.
It comes up occasionally.
It is actively debated.
It is a running public fight.
It is one of the loudest arguments going on right now.

dimensions.what: How uncomfortable would most people be if they were asked this in public?
levels: Anyone would answer this without hesitating.
Some people would rather not answer.
Many people would avoid answering in public.
Most people would refuse to answer on the record.
Almost nobody would answer this publicly.

dimensions.what: Can this statement have a checkable answer at all?
levels: There is no fact of the matter here at all.
It is mostly a matter of opinion.
There is some evidence but no settled answer.
There is a defensible answer.
There is a clear, checkable answer.
